atoms.text: Kimberly lives with her wife in the Lake District. They love their rural home which is situated in the middle of a green forest. The next city is several miles away. Kimberly grew up in central Glasgow. However, once she met Sam, they decided to leave the city and move to the countryside.

The pace of the city was too fast for Kimberly, so she decided to move to a calmer environment. So far, Sam and Kimberly are very happy with their decision. Living in the countryside has one disadvantage though. Every time they need to run an errand, for example to go to the supermarket, they have to drive for an hour to the next larger town.

atoms.text: Kimberly is a sports teacher. In her class, she makes sure that the children are constantly in motion because they spend a lot of time sitting down in their other classes. She teaches many types of sports to the children and hopes that their enthusiasm for sports increases over time.

instruction.text: Match the words with the correct sound.

atoms.text: Recently, Kimberly taught the children how to dance. She showed the children a video clip of a famous dancer who demonstrated some of his dance routines. At first, the children thought that dancing was easy. However, once they tried it themselves, they recognised how challenging it is to move their body in certain ways.
